newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA cotton export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Sales of 166,000 running bales (RB) of Upland were 7 percent below the previous week and 21 percent less than the 4-week average. Major increases were reported for China (45,200 RB), Russia (23,100 RB), Mexico (19,100 RB), and Brazil (16,700 RB). Net sales for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year of 10,100 RB resulted as increases for Guatemala (10,000 RB), Mexico (3,200 RB), and South Korea (3,100 RB) were partly offset by decreases of 6,100 RB for Ecuador.

Exports of 108,400 RB were off one-quarter from the previous week and 27 percent from the 4-week average. Asian destinations accounted for 69 percent of the week's shipments; Western Hemisphere, 24 percent; West European, 5 percent; and African, 2 percent.
